draft.emotion: pleasantly satisfied, tasting a delicious treat
notes: When describing soup or broth, 'ngọt' means naturally savory and rich (from bones, meat, or vegetables), not sugary.
Common in everyday compounds like 'nước ngọt' (soft drink, soda; also fresh water as opposed to saltwater).

senses.definition: Having the pleasant taste of sugar or honey; of broth: naturally savory and rich.
